sections.summary: Official Help Center article defines the setting.

claims.text: The attribution model setting in Google Ads conversion tracking lets you decide how to attribute conversions for each conversion action.

evidence.locator: About attribution models for conversions and bidding — 'The Attribution model setting in conversion tracking...'

sections.summary: The evidence states how the setting affects counting.

claims.text: Changing the attribution model affects how conversions are counted going forward in the 'Conversions' and 'All conversions' columns.

evidence.locator: About attribution models for conversions and bidding — effect on 'Conversions' and 'All conversions' columns

claims.text: The setting applies only to the conversion action it is set on, not account-wide.

evidence.locator: About attribution models for conversions and bidding — 'only affects the conversion action to which it is applied'

claims.text: The setting is a reporting/attribution counting control over how conversions are credited; the packet does not state that changing it affects bidding eligibility or historical figures, so no such effect should be assumed.

sections.summary: The packet identifies which conversion action types can use the setting.

claims.text: The setting can be used for website and Google Analytics conversion actions.

evidence.locator: About attribution models for conversions and bidding — 'You can use this setting for website and Google Analytics conversion actions.'

sections.summary: The evidence confirms the setting exists and its scope, but supplies no navigation path or steps for configuring it, so no setup procedure can be given.

No KPIs are named in the evidence; the only reasonable inference is that the setting changes values in the 'Conversions' and 'All conversions' columns, which are attributed metrics, not incremental outcomes.

claims.text: Values in the 'Conversions' and 'All conversions' columns change as the attribution model changes; these are attributed metrics under the chosen model and should not be read as guaranteed or incremental uplift.

sections.summary: The packet contains no evidence about other platforms' attribution settings or about how this setting compares to Google Analytics' own attribution configuration, so no cross-platform relationship can be honestly stated.
The packet supplies one official source; it carries no check date.

claims.text: Google Ads Help Center article 'About attribution models for conversions and bidding' (source_id: google.ads.attribution), https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/6259715?hl=en; the packet provides no date checked.
